name: Hammer and Swing
design_intent:
HAMMER AND SWING — THE SCRAPWORKS tier-3 FIRST DOUBLE-HAZARD combo (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 §Scrapworks row 16). The flagship three-island / one-void shape combining the circuit's two established families: a LETHAL spinning rotor HAMMER over the centre island B PLUS a NON-lethal wrecking-ball PENDULUM over the B<->C gap. Two pressures at once, but each still individually readable (the two families the circuit already taught). Kill identity = dodge the blade, time the ball, knock rivals into the hammer or off into the void. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%).

HAZARD DOCTRINE: the HAMMER (spinning_hammer) is LETHAL on contact via kill(&ring_out) (never sets last_attacker); slow readable rotation + apex dwell + a hazard-red arc guide; arc centred over B, islands A/C always clear. The PENDULUM (moving_hazard) is NON-lethal (<= 700px/s shove, no hitstun); it dwells up high at each apex (clear beat) and dips into the B<->C gap over the void. The two run on independent clocks so their danger beats are read separately. Spawns are on islands A/C only (never under the blade).

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 top1080 / B x1580..2480 top1080 (the HAMMER stage, center 2030) / C x3160..4060 top1080, 680px void gaps. HAMMER hub at pivot (2030,480), arm_len 590, arc_deg 150, period_s 4.5, phase 0.0, radius 70, head_len 160, head_w 104, dwell_frac 0.24 (head dips to ~body height over B's central strip; apexes rise up and out over the gaps). PENDULUM at pivot (2820,300), arm_len 700, arc_deg 150, period_s 3.4, radius 100, dwell_frac 0.24, phase 0.0 over the B<->C gap (low dip centre (2820,1000) reaching y1100 in the gap). Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878. VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering. Overcast grey open_sky = an industrial yard.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; ~395px trampoline drift / ~527 max spring drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void, the PENDULUM's lane): > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; cross on the ball's apex dwell or get shoved out over the void. Verb: FLY (+ TIME).
- DODGE the HAMMER on B: cross the central strip on the apex-dwell clear beat; a mistimed step at body height = instant off-screen kill. Arc over the gaps is high (above crossing altitude) and never covers A/C. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- RECOVER: island bottoms (1208) to the bottom blast line (1878) = 670px of open sky (>= 650); a pendulum shove adds <= 700px/s, no hitstun -> a fuelled player boosts back. Verb: FLY.
- Neither hazard creates a bounce path across a gap (the ball shoves, the blade kills); every 680px gap exceeds a spring bounce's 527px reach, so flight is REQUIRED. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

SIGNATURE: the first two-family combo — a lethal rotor AND a non-lethal swing on the same stage, the circuit's step up to stacked pressure without going full Mayhem.
